## MYR Group Ranked No. 5 On EC&M’s 2026 Top 50 Electrical Contractors List


We are proud to announce that MYR Group has been ranked #5 on Electrical Construction & Maintenance (EC&M) magazine’s 2026 Top 50 Electrical Contractors list.


The annual ranking recognizes the nation’s largest electrical contractors by revenue, highlighting their performance, resilience, and contributions to the industry. EC&M noted that the Top 50 contractors collectively achieved record-setting revenues in 2025 with an overall increase of 40% in total revenue.


This is MYR Group’s 23rd consecutive year ranking in the Top 5 on EC&M’s list! Our inclusion in the Top 5 once again is a testament to the dedication of our people, the trust of our clients, and the strength of our diversified portfolio of services. MYR Group remains committed to delivering safe, high-quality solutions that power progress and support the nation’s growing infrastructure needs.


[Check out our subsidiaries’ features in the Top 50 Electrical Contractors Project Spotlight gallery](https://www.ecmweb.com/top-50-electrical-contractors/media-gallery/55399445/2026-top-50-electrical-contractors-project-spotlight-part-3)
